I'm on a spot-price electricity contract. Please schedule these appliance cycles for 2024-05-17 so that my electricity cost is as low as possible, without exceeding my household peak load limit:
- dishwasher (dishwasher_1): ready from 12:00, must finish by 21:45
- washing machine (washing_machine_1): ready from 07:15, must finish by 16:30

results.message: Your appliances are scheduled to run as follows: the dishwasher will start at 14:00 and finish by 15:00, while the washing machine will run from 15:00 to 16:30. This schedule keeps your energy costs low and stays within your household peak load limit. Enjoy your clean dishes and laundry!
